proof_body:
by
  rintro a b c ha hb hc ⟨x, hx⟩
  have hn : x * (x.den : ℚ) = (x.num : ℚ) := Rat.mul_den_eq_num x
  have hQ : (a : ℚ) * (x.num : ℚ) ^ 2 + (b : ℚ) * (x.num : ℚ) * ((x.den : ℤ) : ℚ) + (c : ℚ) * ((x.den : ℤ) : ℚ) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    push_cast
    linear_combination (x.den : ℚ) ^ 2 * hx - ((a : ℚ) * ((x.num : ℚ) + x * (x.den : ℚ)) + (b : ℚ) * (x.den : ℚ)) * hn
  have hZ : a * x.num ^ 2 + b * x.num * (x.den : ℤ) + c * (x.den : ℤ) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast hQ
  have hcop : ¬ (Even x.num ∧ Even (x.den : ℤ)) := by
    rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    have h3 : 2 ∣ x.num.natAbs := Int.natCast_dvd.1 (by exact_mod_cast h1.two_dvd)
    have h4 : 2 ∣ x.den := by exact_mod_cast h2.two_dvd
    have h5 := Nat.dvd_gcd h3 h4
    rw [x.reduced] at h5
    omega
  have ha' : ¬ Even a := Int.not_even_iff_odd.2 ha
  have hb' : ¬ Even b := Int.not_even_iff_odd.2 hb
  have hc' : ¬ Even c := Int.not_even_iff_odd.2 hc
  have he : Even (a * x.num ^ 2 + b * x.num * (x.den : ℤ) + c * (x.den : ℤ) ^ 2) := by
    rw [hZ]
    exact Even.zero
  simp only [Int.even_add, Int.even_mul, Int.even_pow, ha', hb', hc'] at he
  tauto
target_source: ∀ (a b c : ℤ), Odd a → Odd b → Odd c → ¬ ∃ x : ℚ, (a : ℚ) * x ^ 2 + (b : ℚ) * x + (c : ℚ) = 0
